params.name: patient_id
params.description: Allows filtering interactions by patient id.

params.name: limit
params.description: Allows limiting the number of interactions returned.

params.name: offset
params.description: Allows offsetting the number of interactions returned.

params.name: created_at
params.description: Allows filtering by date or time. Accepts an object with allowed keys of [gte, gt, lte, lt] and a value of the date or time in iso8601 format. See [advanced querying](https://developers.hint.com/reference/making-requests#advanced-querying) for more information.

params.name: updated_at
params.description: Allows filtering by date or time. Accepts an object with allowed keys of [gte, gt, lte, lt] and a value of the date or time in iso8601 format. See [advanced querying](https://developers.hint.com/reference/making-requests#advanced-querying) for more information.
